name: cur
description: You can use the Amazon Web Services Cost and Usage Report API to programmatically create, query, and delete Amazon Web Services Cost and Usage Report definitions.

subcommands.name: describe-report-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Web Services Cost and Usage Report available to this account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with the specified report definition.

subcommands.name: modify-report-definition
subcommands.description: Allows you to programmatically update your report preferences.

subcommands.name: put-report-definition
subcommands.description: Creates a new report using the description that you provide.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a set of tags with a report definition.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates a set of tags from a report definition.
